data.one_liner: Helper for syncing file attachments between local and remote storage in PowerSync apps
data.what_it_does: It queues uploads, downloads and deletes of files, watches database changes to enqueue work, and integrates with a remote storage adapter.
use_when: You need to keep media files in sync with a remote store while using PowerSync
You want a simple queue that reacts to database changes
avoid_when: You plan to use the upcoming core PowerSync attachments library
You need advanced custom storage backends not supported by the helper
strengths: Built for PowerSync, handles queueing and watching DB changes
Supports multiple platforms (Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux)
Uses standard Flutter plugins like path_provider
weaknesses: Will be replaced by core library, future features limited
No support for custom local storage implementations
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, import package, implement AbstractRemoteStorageAdapter, initialize queue in main.dart
